rules: Protected user records are not silently overwritten.
Scoped JSON overrides only matching fields inside its declared scope.
User-authored changes have the highest source priority.
Every import is previewed, validated, and reversible.
Player-safe views never reveal private, secret, or protected fields.
Ancestry or species never dictates morality, intelligence, profession, culture, politics, or personality.
Gender identity and pronouns govern dialogue and social language.
NPC reactions use goals, needs, fears, relationships, factions, quest state, schedules, hazards, law, player actions, and accepted consequences.
